auth_google_client_id.label: Google OAuth Client ID
auth_google_client_id.help: Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Web Client ID.

auth_line_channel_id.label: LINE Login Channel ID
auth_line_channel_id.help: Apply for the OpenID Connect Email scope in LINE Developers.

auth_oauth_flow_ttl_seconds.label: Sign-in flow lifetime (seconds)
auth_oauth_flow_ttl_seconds.help: One-time state, nonce and PKCE values are kept for 10 minutes by default.

auth_oauth_ip_limit.label: Flow starts per IP per hour

ga4_enabled.label: Also send GA4 cookieless events
ga4_enabled.help: Sends scrubbed events only while every Consent Mode signal is denied, and stores no GA cookie on this site.

ga4_measurement_id.label: GA4 Measurement ID
ga4_measurement_id.help: Formatted G-...; a public identifier, not a Data API key.

analytics_trust_country_header.label: Trust the proxy's country header
analytics_trust_country_header.help: Reads only the two-letter code the BFF forwards from a configured trusted proxy header; unknown when unset.

analytics_retention_days.label: Raw event retention (days)
analytics_retention_days.help: 90 days by default; the maintenance job deletes older rows.

registration_enabled.label: Open public registration
registration_enabled.help: When off, no new account (including the environment admin emails) can self-register; existing members still sign in.

access_token_expire_minutes.label: Session lifetime (minutes)
access_token_expire_minutes.help: How long a newly issued sign-in token lasts (5–1440). Takes effect on the next sign-in or renewal without a redeploy; existing tokens keep their own lifetime until their renewal point.

session_absolute_max_days.label: Absolute sign-in cap (days)
session_absolute_max_days.help: However often it renews, one sign-in lasts at most this many days (1–365) before a fresh sign-in is required.

google_maps_javascript_enabled.label: Enable the browser route map
google_maps_javascript_enabled.help: A safety gate. Turn it on only after confirming the Maps JavaScript API is enabled and the browser key is restricted to mokaair.com and www.mokaair.com; while off, transit plans and exact external navigation still work.

hotspot_guide_ai_default_provider.label: Default vendor for hotspot AI search

hotspot_guide_ai_daily_call_budget.label: AI model calls per day
hotspot_guide_ai_daily_call_budget.help: Administrator searches cost members nothing but are counted against this budget and logged in the audit trail.

flight_provider_mode.label: Flight search source
flight_provider_mode.help: Hybrid mode keeps querying the next source until the itinerary count reaches the threshold; extra sources do not cost another search.

flight_min_result_count.label: Top-up threshold
flight_min_result_count.help: Query the next provider when fewer deduplicated itineraries than this remain.

hotel_provider_mode.label: Hotel search source
hotel_provider_mode.help: Automatic mode uses Amadeus until the Booking.com Demand API is approved.

provider_timeout_seconds.label: Provider timeout (seconds)
provider_timeout_seconds.help: Maximum wait for one external request.

naver_place_cache_ttl_seconds.label: NAVER place cache (seconds)
naver_place_cache_ttl_seconds.help: Place details are cached in Redis under an opaque id; 15 minutes by default.

naver_maps_monthly_request_limit.label: Monthly reminder quota
naver_maps_monthly_request_limit.help: An optional internal reminder threshold, not NAVER's free tier or a billing cap; 0 means unset.

weather_cache_ttl_seconds.label: Weather cache (seconds)
weather_cache_ttl_seconds.help: Google Weather is cached for 15 minutes by default to cut repeat queries.

google_maps_essentials_free_limit.label: Essentials free calls per SKU
google_maps_essentials_free_limit.help: Public pricing defaults to 10,000 per SKU per month; adjust here if your contract differs.

google_maps_pro_free_limit.label: Pro free calls per SKU
google_maps_pro_free_limit.help: Public pricing defaults to 5,000 per SKU per month.

google_maps_enterprise_free_limit.label: Enterprise free calls per SKU
google_maps_enterprise_free_limit.help: Public pricing defaults to 1,000 per SKU per month.

restaurant_scan_enabled.label: Scan restaurants around hotspots
restaurant_scan_enabled.help: When off, no Nearby, Aggregate or restaurant Details requests are sent.

restaurant_aggregate_monthly_budget.label: Restaurant Aggregate monthly cap
restaurant_aggregate_monthly_budget.help: 4,000 by default, keeping 20% of the public Places Aggregate free tier in reserve.

restaurant_nearby_monthly_budget.label: Restaurant Nearby monthly cap
restaurant_nearby_monthly_budget.help: 800 by default, used for live popular restaurants on the public site.

restaurant_details_monthly_budget.label: Restaurant Details monthly cap
restaurant_details_monthly_budget.help: 800 by default; shared with other Place Details calls and stopped before the free tier runs out.

restaurant_scan_batch_call_limit.label: Calls per restaurant scan batch
restaurant_scan_batch_call_limit.help: At most 50 every six hours by default; progress is kept and hotspots rotate.

restaurant_location_cache_days.label: Restaurant coordinate Redis TTL (days)
restaurant_location_cache_days.help: Only coordinates are cached; default and maximum are both 30 days, after which Redis drops them.

hotspot_guide_youtube_daily_search_budge.label: Automatic searches per day
hotspot_guide_youtube_daily_search_budge.help: 80 by default, leaving 20 of the daily Search Queries quota for administrators.

hotspot_guide_youtube_search_daily_free_.label: Search Queries daily quota
hotspot_guide_youtube_search_daily_free_.help: YouTube allows 100 search.list queries a day by default; adjust if your Cloud project has a different quota.

hotspot_guide_youtube_core_daily_free_li.label: Core API daily quota
hotspot_guide_youtube_core_daily_free_li.help: YouTube allows 10,000 units a day by default; each videos.list request currently costs 1 unit.

hotspot_guide_gemini_base_url.label: Gemini API Base URL
hotspot_guide_gemini_base_url.help: Only Google's official generativelanguage domains are accepted.

hotspot_guide_backfill_enabled.label: Backfill hotspots without a guide
hotspot_guide_backfill_enabled.help: Each background round picks hotspots with no video or article yet and searches for them, map-verified ones first. When off, only administrators search by hand.

hotspot_guide_backfill_batch_size.label: Hotspots per round
hotspot_guide_backfill_batch_size.help: The most hotspots one round handles. The actual number is still bounded by each search provider's daily quota; when it runs out the round stops there.

hotspot_guide_backfill_locale.label: Backfill locales
hotspot_guide_backfill_locale.help: A comma-separated list processed in order, e.g. zh-TW,ja,ko,en,zh-CN. Every hotspot gets something in the first locale before the second starts; each hotspot searches one locale per round, so listing five locales does not multiply the quota by five. A hotspot searched without result is not retried in that locale for 30 days.

navitime_api_base_url.label: API Base URL
navitime_api_base_url.help: For RapidAPI use https://navitime-route-totalnavi.p.rapidapi.com; for a direct contract use the gateway host NAVITIME provides (navitime.co.jp / navitime.biz).

navitime_monthly_request_limit.label: Monthly request cap
navitime_monthly_request_limit.help: NAVITIME requests sent by this site, counted per month in Japan time; at the cap calls stop and a Google Maps link is shown instead. 450 by default, leaving room under RapidAPI Basic's 500 for admin tests; 0 counts without limiting.

ekispert_api_base_url.label: API Base URL
ekispert_api_base_url.help: Fixed to Ekispert's official https://api.ekispert.jp; third-party relay hosts are refused.

ekispert_search_type.label: Route data mode
ekispert_search_type.help: plain does not mean a dated timetable; pick departure only once the contract is confirmed to include timetable search.

ekispert_monthly_request_limit.label: Monthly request cap
ekispert_monthly_request_limit.help: At the cap external calls stop and exact Google Maps navigation is offered instead; 450 by default, 0 counts without limiting.

odsay_language.label: Route data language
odsay_language.help: The ODsay Standard plan only serves Korean; pick another language only if the contract includes multilingual service.

odsay_daily_request_limit.label: Daily request cap
odsay_daily_request_limit.help: The Basic plan allows 30 a day; the site uses 25 by default and keeps 5 for tests. Adjust to your commercial contract; 0 counts without limiting.

travelpayouts_static_url_template.label: Fallback partner link
travelpayouts_static_url_template.help: Used only when the Partner Links API fails; may contain '{destination}', '{departure_date}', '{return_date}' and '{sub_id}'.

travelpayouts_connectivity_target_url.label: eSIM target URL
travelpayouts_connectivity_target_url.help: Falls back to the activities target URL when empty.

travelpayouts_allowed_hosts.label: Allowed redirect hosts
travelpayouts_allowed_hosts.help: Comma-separated; only HTTPS URLs on these hosts are allowed.

trip_com_affiliate_url_template.label: Full partner link generated in the partner console
trip_com_affiliate_url_template.help: Existing Trip.com tracking parameters are never overwritten.

booking_demand_env.label: Demand API environment
booking_demand_env.help: After switching to production, save and run the connection test again.

booking_demand_api_base_url.label: Demand API v3.1 Base URL
booking_demand_api_base_url.help: Only Booking.com's official sandbox or production domains are accepted.

booking_demand_affiliate_id.label: Demand API Affiliate ID
booking_demand_affiliate_id.help: Stored separately from the affiliate redirect ID; the Affiliate section's ID is used only when this is empty.

booking_booker_country.label: Booker country code
booking_booker_country.help: Two-letter lowercase country code; Taiwan uses tw.

openai_model.label: OpenAI model
openai_model.help: Model used when trip planning calls OpenAI. Pick “Custom…” to enter an unlisted ID.

anthropic_model.label: Claude model
anthropic_model.help: Model used when trip planning calls Claude. Pick “Custom…” to enter an unlisted ID.

minimax_model.label: MiniMax model
minimax_model.help: Model used when trip planning calls MiniMax. Pick “Custom…” to enter an unlisted ID.

gemini_model.label: Gemini model
gemini_model.help: Model used when trip planning or trip text parsing calls Gemini. Pick “Custom…” to enter an unlisted ID.

hotspot_guide_ai_openai_model.label: OpenAI model
hotspot_guide_ai_openai_model.help: Only affects hotspot guide search. Leave empty to reuse the trip planner OpenAI model.

hotspot_guide_ai_anthropic_model.label: Claude model
hotspot_guide_ai_anthropic_model.help: Only affects hotspot guide search. Leave empty to reuse the trip planner Claude model.

hotspot_guide_ai_minimax_model.label: MiniMax model
hotspot_guide_ai_minimax_model.help: Only affects hotspot guide search. Leave empty to reuse the trip planner MiniMax model.

hotspot_guide_ai_gemini_model.label: Gemini model
hotspot_guide_ai_gemini_model.help: Only affects hotspot guide search. Leave empty to reuse the trip planner Gemini model.

hotspot_guide_gemini_model.label: Gemini model
hotspot_guide_gemini_model.help: Flash-tier models build hotspot candidate lists well but are weaker at listing grounded article sources; Pro-tier models may be unavailable to new API keys, so rely on the connection test.

usage.title: Plans and usage charges
usage.description: Manage registration grants, public usage packs, and the number of uses charged by each feature. Changes apply only to new operations.

trial.title: Registration trial uses
trial.help: Applies only to accounts created after saving. Existing member balances do not change.

packages.title: Public usage packs
packages.help: Active plans appear on the pricing page in display order. Payment is not included in this feature.
packages.archiveConfirm: Archive “{name}”? Historical ledgers will not be changed.
packages.name: Plan name

costs.title: Charges by feature
costs.help: Zero makes a feature free. New values do not change operations that have already started or completed.

travel_search.label: Standard trip search
travel_search.help: A standard flight, hotel, or activity search.

flexible_flight_search.label: Flexible-date flight search
flexible_flight_search.help: A flight search with flexible dates enabled.

full_trip_search.label: Full trip search
full_trip_search.help: Optimizes a trip across at least three modules.

multi_city_search.label: Multi-city search
multi_city_search.help: Searches a trip containing multiple flight legs.

back_to_back_fare_search.label: Public back-to-back comparison
back_to_back_fare_search.help: Compares two trips using public fares.

live_back_to_back_fare_search.label: Live back-to-back comparison
live_back_to_back_fare_search.help: Compares back-to-back fares through live providers.

flight_status_lookup.label: Flight status lookup
flight_status_lookup.help: Checks live flight status by number or route.

ai_itinerary_generation.label: AI itinerary planning
ai_itinerary_generation.help: Generates a day or complete itinerary with AI.

ai_itinerary_refine.label: AI itinerary refinement
ai_itinerary_refine.help: Re-plans a day or the whole trip from an intent typed by the traveller.

itinerary_optimization.label: Route optimization
itinerary_optimization.help: Applies optimized routing to an existing itinerary.

price_reoptimization.label: Trip repricing
price_reoptimization.help: Reprices and reoptimizes an existing trip.

audit.title: Recent admin history
audit.help: Records the operator, target, and before-and-after values.
audit.empty: No plan or charge changes have been recorded yet.

analytics.title: Traffic and product analytics
analytics.description: Understand traffic, acquisition, and the core product funnel using first-party data without exposing individual member activity.
analytics.loadError: Analytics data could not be loaded.
analytics.funnelRollup: Daily aggregate counts are used beyond raw-event retention.
analytics.authoritativeHelp: Calculated directly from member, search, trip, and affiliate tables and kept separate from browser event metrics.
analytics.heatmapHelp: Public page views shown in Asia/Taipei time.
analytics.heatmapUnavailable: Hourly data is unavailable for this range.

layout.title: Layout management
layout.description: Control which public features and pages are visible. Disabling one hides the Web interface only; it does not disable APIs or delete existing data.
layout.saveSuccess: Layout settings saved and the public state has been refreshed.
layout.auditDescription: Records only the operator, fields that actually changed, and the resulting values.

hotspots_enabled.label: Popular hotspots
hotspots_enabled.help: Controls hotspot navigation and the /hotspots page.

trips_enabled.label: My trips
trips_enabled.help: Controls trip navigation, save-trip actions, and pages under /trips. Read-only share links remain available.

alerts_enabled.label: Price alerts
alerts_enabled.help: Controls alert navigation, create-alert actions, and the /alerts page.

flight_status_enabled.label: Flight status
flight_status_enabled.help: Controls flight-status navigation and the /flights/status page.

airline_fares_enabled.label: Airline fare lab
airline_fares_enabled.help: Controls the airline-fares entry and the /labs/airlines page.

pricing_enabled.label: Plans & usage packs
pricing_enabled.help: Controls pricing navigation, usage-pack actions, and the /pricing page.

hotspotPlacesPanel.title: Maps, opening hours and official sites
hotspotPlacesPanel.subtitle: Place IDs are kept; every other Google field is cached for at most 30 days.
hotspotPlacesPanel.usageLine: This month: Place Details Enterprise {details}/{detailsLimit} · Text Search Pro {search}/{searchLimit}
hotspotPlacesPanel.estimateHint: About {count} calls on the first pass; the real number depends on the Place IDs already stored.
hotspotPlacesPanel.confirmUsage: I have checked the estimated Google API usage
hotspotPlacesPanel.forceRefresh: Refresh data that has not expired
hotspotPlacesPanel.runStarted: The Google place data job has been queued
hotspotPlacesPanel.runCounts: Done {processed}/{total} · published {published} · in review {pending} · unmatched {unmatched} · failed {failed} · Google {actual}/{estimated}
hotspotPlacesPanel.empty: No place data matches those filters

deploymentsPanel.reasonDisabled: The host has deployment turned off
deploymentsPanel.reasonAgentOffline: The deploy agent is not connected
deploymentsPanel.reasonCiNotGreen: The newest main has not passed CI
deploymentsPanel.reasonUpToDate: Already on the newest green build
deploymentsPanel.reconnecting: The service is restarting. The deploy log is still on the host agent and this page keeps reconnecting.
deploymentsPanel.noCommitSubject: No subject for the newest main commit yet
deploymentsPanel.historyHint: Only sanitised stages and outcomes; the host's raw log is never shown.
deploymentsPanel.warningStrong: There may be a short outage.
deploymentsPanel.warningBody: A PostgreSQL backup is taken first. If the new build fails its health checks only the application is rolled back — migrations are not downgraded and the database is not restored automatically.

dashboard.title: Operations overview
dashboard.description: See what is published, what is waiting for review and how members stand, then open the module you need.

providers.title: APIs and providers
providers.description: Live flights, stays, activities, Google Maps and the Japanese routing services in one place; keys only ever reach the encrypted server-side store.

system.title: System settings
system.description: Open registration, provider run modes and the service's protective limits; a save applies to the very next request.

hotspots.title: Attraction review
hotspots.description: Attractions, place data, guides in five languages and nearby restaurant candidates: discover, approve, reject and retire them here.

users.title: Members and usage
users.description: Find members, manage accounts and admin rights, and add or deduct uses through an auditable ledger.

deployments.title: Deployment centre
deployments.description: Only the newest main that passed CI ships. A restricted host agent runs the backup, the migration, the health checks and the application rollback.

usersPanel.adjustInvalid: Enter a whole number other than 0: positive adds, negative deducts.
usersPanel.listHint: Email search matches part of an address; results are ordered by sign-up date.
usersPanel.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own account.
usersPanel.ledgerBalance: Ledger balance {count}; a deduction may not take it below the reserved amount.
usersPanel.adjustHint: Positive adds, negative deducts; the reason and who did it go into the ledger for good.
usersPanel.selfAllowed: ADMIN_EMAILS grants this account, so it may adjust its own balance.
usersPanel.selfBlocked: An admin cannot adjust their own balance; ask another admin.
usersPanel.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. support credit, fixing a bad top-up

hotspotsPanel.candidateFound: Candidate found; compare the name and address by hand.
hotspotsPanel.depthReasonPlaceholder: Why it is a deep-travel spot
hotspotsPanel.locationHint: Places candidate coordinates are for comparison only; a permanent coordinate needs an independent source.
hotspotsPanel.applyPlaceId: Apply Place ID (still needs a person to confirm)
hotspotsPanel.empty: No candidate hotspots match these filters

foodMerchantsPanel.verifiedActivated: {count} merchants set to verified, approved and active.
foodMerchantsPanel.noNonKorean: None of the selected merchants outside Korea can use the Google candidate search.
foodMerchantsPanel.batchDone: Google candidate search finished for {total} merchants, {found} with a candidate{skipped}. Compare each one before applying.
foodMerchantsPanel.placeApplied: {name}: Place ID applied, still awaiting a person's review.
foodMerchantsPanel.candidateFound: Candidate found; compare the name and address before applying the Place ID.
foodMerchantsPanel.title: Merchants, map identity and permanent coordinates
foodMerchantsPanel.description: Unverified bootstrap candidates are never public. Google Places coordinates are for comparison only; a permanent coordinate needs an official or administrator-checked source.
foodMerchantsPanel.batchVerify: Set verified and active in batch
foodMerchantsPanel.candidatesHint: Candidate coordinates are for comparison only and are never written as permanent coordinates. Confirm the name and address, then apply the Place ID one by one.
foodMerchantsPanel.notConfigured: Google Places auto-matching is not configured.

foodMerchantsPanel.temporaryCoordinates: Temporary match coordinates (not a permanent source):
foodMerchantsPanel.sourcesHint: A regional tourism page is only destination context; only a page that lists this merchant, or the merchant's own site, can vouch for its name, address, website and ride-hailing coordinates.

auth_google_client_secret.label: Google OAuth Client Secret
auth_google_client_secret.help: Encrypted and kept on the server only.

auth_line_channel_secret.label: LINE Channel Secret
auth_line_channel_secret.help: Used only for the LINE Login token exchange.

auth_apple_private_key.label: Apple .p8 Private Key
auth_apple_private_key.help: Paste the PEM or write newlines as \n; encrypted and kept on the server only.

openai_api_key.label: OpenAI API Key
openai_api_key.help: Encrypted on the server; never sent to the browser.

anthropic_api_key.label: Anthropic API Key
anthropic_api_key.help: Used for the Claude Messages API.

minimax_api_key.label: MiniMax API Key
minimax_api_key.help: Used for the MiniMax Responses API.

google_maps_api_key.label: Server API key
google_maps_api_key.help: Enable Places API (New), Routes API and Weather API; restricting it to the host's egress IP is recommended.

next_public_google_maps_browser_key.label: Browser map key
next_public_google_maps_browser_key.help: Entering a key does not load the map by itself: enable the Maps JavaScript API, allow https://mokaair.com/* and https://www.mokaair.com/*, then open the safety gate above once verified.

naver_maps_client_id.label: NAVER Cloud Client ID
naver_maps_client_id.help: Used by the server API and the browser Dynamic Map; the public browser value must be restricted to the production site's origin.

naver_maps_client_secret.label: NAVER Cloud Client Secret
naver_maps_client_secret.help: Encrypted on the server and never returned to the browser.

navitime_client_id.label: Client ID
navitime_client_id.help: Needed only for a direct contract, where it goes into the request path; leave empty when using a RapidAPI key.

navitime_api_key.label: API Key
navitime_api_key.help: RapidAPI's X-RapidAPI-Key (Basic plan: 500 calls a month) or a direct-contract key.

ekispert_api_key.label: Ekispert Access Key
ekispert_api_key.help: Encrypted on the server; route requests send it as the official key parameter.

odsay_api_key.label: ODsay Server Key
odsay_api_key.help: Use a Server Key bound to the production server's fixed egress IP, not a browser Web Key.

hotspot_guide_youtube_api_key.label: YouTube Data API Key
hotspot_guide_youtube_api_key.help: Used only for video search; the daily quota is governed by the caps above.

hotspot_guide_brave_api_key.label: Brave Search API Key
hotspot_guide_brave_api_key.help: Encrypted and kept on the server only.

hotspot_guide_gemini_api_key.label: Gemini API Key
hotspot_guide_gemini_api_key.help: Used for multilingual article search and hotspot candidate generation; encrypted on the server.

settingsPanel.usageUnavailable: Usage counters are unavailable right now
settingsPanel.skuTitle: Free tier per SKU this month
settingsPanel.skuHint: Each SKU has its own free tier; another SKU's remainder cannot offset an overage.
settingsPanel.googlePeriodNote: Billing period in Google Pacific Time: {start} to {end}. The site counts every server request it sends (failures included) but not browser embeds or history before counting began; billable events, credits and invoices are what Google Cloud Console says.
settingsPanel.naverTitle: NAVER Maps server usage this month
settingsPanel.naverNote: Billing months follow Korea time. The site records only server requests to Local Search, Geocoding and Directions 5, not browser Dynamic Map loads, and this is not NAVER's billing; check NAVER Cloud Console for real usage and cost.
settingsPanel.navitimeNote: route_transit requests sent by the site (failures and admin tests included), counted per month in Japan time; at the cap the site stops calling NAVITIME and shows a Google Maps link instead. RapidAPI's quota resets on the subscription day, so check the RapidAPI dashboard for real usage.
settingsPanel.ekispertNote: Every search/course request sent (failures and admin tests included), counted per month in Japan time. At the safety cap calls stop and exact Google Maps navigation is shown instead; the contract quota and cost are what Ekispert's console says.
settingsPanel.odsayNote: searchPubTransPathT requests (failures and admin tests included), counted per day in Korea time. The default of 25 is a conservative gate under the Basic plan's 30 a day; adjust to your ODsay contract and set the fixed-IP restriction in the provider console.
settingsPanel.poolsHint: Search Queries and Core API quotas are counted separately and cannot offset each other.
settingsPanel.autoBudgetOver: The automatic search cap of {budget} a day exceeds the current Search Queries quota of {quota}; lower the cap.
settingsPanel.autoBudgetOk: At most {budget} searches a day; the current settings keep {reserve} for administrator searches and connection tests.
settingsPanel.youtubePeriodNote: The daily quota resets in Google Pacific Time; the current billing day is {date}. The site counts every server search.list and videos.list request it sends (failures included) but not traffic before counting began, from other services or from other Cloud projects; the real quota and any adjustments are what Google Cloud Console says.
settingsPanel.runtimeSaved: System settings saved and applied immediately.
settingsPanel.providerSaved: {label} settings were encrypted, saved and applied immediately.
settingsPanel.loadErrorTitle: The admin console could not be opened
settingsPanel.loadErrorHint: Set ADMIN_EMAILS on the host first, or set the account's is_admin to true.
settingsPanel.secretsHint: The database stores only Fernet-encrypted content and the screen shows only the last four characters. This session derives the key from {source}; in production, pin SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
settingsPanel.clearAfterSave: Admin value is cleared on save
settingsPanel.blankKeyHint: A blank key does not overwrite the stored value; after clearing, the host environment value is used.
settingsPanel.auditSystemHint: Records only the changed fields, the actor and the resulting registration state, never sensitive values.
settingsPanel.auditProviderHint: Records only the changed field names, the actor and test results, never key material.
